ui_bugs.issue: Fleet picker renders rows for equipment_master entries with EMPTY unit_number (visible as bullet-only rows '· Air Compressors' with no leading text). Picking such a row sets selected.unit_number='' and the subsequent GET /api/equipment-parts/ + PUT /api/equipment-parts/ requests hit a trailing-slash URL that the K8s ingress responds to with a 307 redirect to http:// (NOT https://) — browsers BLOCK that as Mixed Content (visible in console: 'Mixed Content: requested an insecure XMLHttpRequest endpoint http://...'). Result: no 'Catalog saved.' toast fires when the user tries to save against an empty-unit row. Order send happens to work because POST /equipment-parts/order has no path param.

action_items: Filter out fleet entries with empty/whitespace unit_number in PartsCatalog.jsx (e.g. `useMemo(() => fleet.filter(u => (u.unit_number||'').trim()), [fleet])`) so they don't show in parts-fleet-list and can't be picked.

Optionally: backend GET/PUT /api/equipment-parts/{unit_number} should 400 when the path-decoded unit_number is empty/whitespace (today FastAPI happily routes /api/equipment-parts/ to the LIST endpoint after a 307, then PUT 405s — but both calls travel via http first).
Optionally: investigate why the K8s ingress 307-redirects HTTPS → HTTP on trailing slashes for some paths. This is a latent platform issue but is masked by always-correct URLs in other components.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth gate returns 403 (not 401) when no X-Shop-Token / X-Admin-Token is supplied. Test report templates (and the original review_request) said 401. Recommend documenting the actual 403 behavior or switching require_shop_or_admin to raise 401 for consistency with HTTP semantics (401 = no auth, 403 = wrong auth).

POST /api/admin/equipment-parts/upload replaces ALL category lists for the affected units (line 2603: 'existing[c] = cats[c]  # replace category fully on upload') — destructive against any in-progress mechanic edits on the same unit. Document this clearly in the admin UI ('Upload OVERWRITES every category for the units listed in the CSV') or switch to merge-by-(name,part_number) on uploads.

PartsOrderRequest does not enforce minimum length on items[] / send_to[] at the Pydantic layer — relies on manual checks in the route. If a future caller bypasses the route helper, validation is lost. Consider min_length=1 on both fields.

/api/equipment-parts/{unit_number} accepts unit_number with arbitrary characters; empty string after url-decoding will route to the LIST endpoint via FastAPI's slash-redirect. Add `if not unit_number.strip(): raise HTTPException(400)` at the top of get/put/delete handlers as a defense-in-depth.

rca of the issue: The empty-unit-row bug originates from equipment_master rows lacking a unit_number field (schema permits it). PartsCatalog's fleet filter uses .toLowerCase() on unit_number but doesn't reject empty values. When picked, selected.unit_number = '' triggers axios calls to '/api/equipment-parts/' (note trailing slash). The Emergent K8s ingress on FastAPI returns a 307 Temporary Redirect with Location header set to http:// (HTTP not HTTPS) for trailing-slash mismatches — likely because uvicorn doesn't honor X-Forwarded-Proto when generating the redirect URL. The browser obeys CSP/Mixed-Content rules and silently blocks the redirected XHR. Fix: PartsCatalog.jsx line ~70 (fleet useMemo): add `.filter(u => (u.unit_number||'').trim())` before the search filter.
